<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*A gunman opens fire at a police station in [[Paso Robles, California]], injuring a deputy with the [[San Luis Obispo County, California|San Luis Obispo]] Sheriff's Office. He then flees and kills a transient, leading to a manhunt. [https://www.sfgate.com/news/article/Gunman-shoots-at-California-police-station-15329865.php (''The San Francisco Chronicle'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Assam gas and oil leak]]
**Two [[firefighter]]s are killed and four others are injured in a Baghjan gas well [[Blowout (well drilling)|blowout fire]] in [[Assam]], [[Northeast India]]. [https://indianexpress.com/article/north-east-india/assam/assam-gas-leak-firefighters-death-injuries-6451909/ (''Indian Express'')]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**A day after [[North Korea]] severed its hotlines with [[South Korea]] over [[North Korean defectors|defectors]] who sent anti-[[government of North Korea|Pyongyang]] leaflets to [[Military Demarcation Line|the border]], South Korea announces it is taking legal action against two organisations that conducted such operations, saying that they "have created tension between the two Koreas and caused danger to the border-area residents' lives and safety". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southkorea-defectors/south-korea-acts-to-stop-defectors-sending-aid-messages-to-north-korea-idUSKBN23H1BF?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Proposed United States acquisition of Greenland]]
**[[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] announces that the [[United States]] has reopened [[List of diplomatic missions of the United States|its consulate]] in [[Nuuk]], [[Greenland]], a year after [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] expressed his interest in purchasing the island, as part of a effort from the [[White House]] to expand U.S. presence in the [[Arctic]] and curb influence from [[China]] and [[Russia]]. [https://www.politico.eu/article/us-makes-greenland-return-after-trump-attempt-to-buy-it-us-consulate/ (Politico EU)]
*[[Territorial disputes of India and Nepal]]
**The [[Federal Parliament of Nepal|Nepali parliament]] moves to approve a new map and revision of the [[Emblem of Nepal|national emblem]] which includes territory in [[India]]'s [[Uttarakhand]] state. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/nepal-parliament-moves-to-approve-new-map/articleshow/76290511.cms (''Times of India'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Assassination of Olof Palme]]
**Sweden closes the case of the murder of [[Prime Minister of Sweden|Prime Minister]] [[Olof Palme]] in 1986 after 34 years of investigation, indicating [[Stig Engström (suspected murderer)|Stig Engström]] as the suspected murderer. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/06/10/europe/sweden-olof-palme-murder-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Killing of George Floyd]], [[Police reform in the United States]]
**Several people, including [[George Floyd]]'s brother, testify about [[police brutality]] and [[Institutional racism|systemic racism]] before the [[United States House Committee on the Judiciary|U.S. House Judiciary Committee]] in support of the [[Justice in Policing Act of 2020]]. [https://www.npr.org/2020/06/10/873865317/please-listen-george-floyd-s-brother-testifies-in-house-judiciary-hearing (NPR)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Polish presidential election]], [[LGBT rights in Poland]]
**Ahead of the upcoming presidential election, President [[Andrzej Duda]] vows to ban teaching about LGBT issues in Polish schools in a bid to secure re-election. Duda is a staunch ally of the ruling [[Right-wing populism|right-wing populist]] [[Law and Justice (Poland)|Law and Justice]] party. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-election-lgbt/polish-president-says-he-would-ban-lgbt-teaching-in-schools-idUSKBN23H2BU (Reuters)]
*[[2020 Sri Lankan parliamentary election]]
**[[Sri Lanka]] postpones, for a second time, the election from June 20 to August 5 due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka|COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sri-lanka-politics-election/sri-lanka-delays-general-election-for-second-time-sets-august-5-as-new-date-idUSKBN23H1RW?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[Modern display of the Confederate battle flag]]
**[[NASCAR]] announces that the display of the [[Flags of the Confederate States of America|Confederate flag]] will be prohibited from all of its events and properties. [https://www.espn.com/racing/nascar/story/_/id/29293767/nascar-bans-confederate-flags-racetracks (ESPN)]
